messages:
Ana Rivera: heads-up — sketched a lightweight plan to add 'route_policy_v2' and 'quota_bucket_id' to console_events without a big backfill. want quick sanity check.
Sam K: can you paste the minimal migration?
Ana Rivera: sure. plan: dual-write new fields from ingest for 2 weeks, keep reads on old shape but allow a feature-flagged read path that prefers v2 when present. fallback to v1 for safety.
Ana Rivera: SQL sketch:```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN quota_bucket_id text;
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN route_policy_v2 jsonb;
-- no index yet, we'll add partial index after traffic probe
COMMIT;
```
Devon Li: partial index later is good. watch cardinality on quota_bucket_id — could explode dash queries. maybe hash-prefix it for indexes.
Michelle: agree on index caution. also need telemetry names mapping: we currently emit route_policy as string keys -> need small transform before writing v2. e.g. {"latency_sla": "low"} -> {"sla": "low"}.
Ana Rivera: yep — ingest will do a mapping shim. telemetry folks: observability-bot any concerns on metrics?
observability-bot: note: new field route_policy_v2 will be visible in console-telemetry. recommend adding a quick metric for dualwrite-success-rate and a p99 write latency probe.
Sam K: rollout plan: start with canary tenant subset (5%) -> monitor dualwrite-success-rate and dashboard query p50/p99. after 24h, open to 25%, then 100% if no regressions.
Michelle: what about queries in the console that join to analytics table? they expect route_policy string. we'll need a compatibility read adapter in console-api that reads v2 if present and transforms to old shape for UI until UI rollout.
Devon Li: I can add adapter in console-api. suggestion: feature-flag on per-route so we can A/B test query perf.
Ana Rivera: decision checkpoint: do we want to backfill older rows for quota_bucket_id before enabling quota enforcement? my take: defer backfill, treat null as legacy-global-bucket until we run a controlled async backfill. reduces write window risk.
Sam K: +1. avoid heavy backfill up-front. create backfill job that paginates by create_time and mark safepoints.
Michelle: add a small user-facing doc blurb about quota reports changing semantics once backfill completes. ops will need heads-up.
Devon Li: release-bot: can you create canary release for console-api with adapter flag?
release-bot: created release candidate rc/2026-03-console-schema-adapter v0.1 (canary flag: enable_route_v2_adapter).
Ana Rivera: thanks. next: after 2 weeks dualwrite, we'll run a dry-run backfill on a snapshot to measure index size and run cost estimate. if within 10% of estimate, proceed with production backfill schedule.
Sam K: sounds good. I'll add a short runbook for rollback: feature-flag off -> stop dualwrites -> drop new partial index if created during probe.
Michelle: tagging support and documentation tasks in the migration card. I'll update the UX/metrics note. :+1:
Ana Rivera: perfect — I'll kick off the canary tomorrow and post a short status summary in this thread.
